items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: He played with me for the longest time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Okay, at that period, then, what about people like Alton Red? Did he come later?

items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: I remember just as well, as it was just yesterday. I can see him standin' up here now; we called him Red. And he got a saxophone, and I got one, too. That's what made me start to playin' a saxophone.
